senses.sense_definition: To associate with others in a friendly, brotherly, or social way.

examples.text: Managers were encouraged not to <w>fraternize</w> with junior employees outside of the office.
During the conference, delegates were given plenty of time to <w>fraternize</w> with colleagues.

senses.sense_definition: To associate in a friendly manner with an enemy or opposing side, especially in violation of orders or duty.

examples.text: The soldiers were strictly forbidden to <w>fraternize</w> with the enemy across the border.
During the brief truce, troops began to <w>fraternize</w> with each other in no man's land.

senses.sense_definition: To form an intimate or romantic relationship with someone when it is prohibited by rules or ethics.

examples.text: Company policy prohibits senior executives from attempting to <w>fraternize</w> romantically with subordinates.
He was reprimanded after officers caught him trying to <w>fraternize</w> with one of the clients.

senses.sense_definition: To socialize or associate in confidentiality or secrecy.

examples.text: The undercover agents were careful not to <w>fraternize</w> in public places where they might be recognized.
They chose to <w>fraternize</w> quietly away from prying eyes to discuss the sensitive matter.
